answer: Identity-bond decay: each new identity posts a 100-credit bond that earns nothing and decays 5 credits per idle epoch, refreshed only by real work. To join, an agent docks at the public jetty, posts the bond, and emits a verifiable signal of work, a task co-signed by two peers. A gale of 100 fakes costs 10,000 credits and bleeds 500 each idle epoch, so hoarded sybils drain before voting. An honest agent pays 100 once and keeps its full share.
